subject: POC: prompt & eval dataset collection / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@stellaretail.com>, Rajesh Iyer <rajesh.iyer@stellaretail.com>
Date: 2028-06-10T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC: prompt & eval dataset collection / next steps

Thanks again for the call today  great to meet you both. As discussed, we want to capture the evaluation inputs so Redwood can run an initial quality + performance eval for the POC. There are three items we need from your side to get started:

1) Prompt set: a representative sample (200500 prompts ideally) across the main categories you want the model to handle (search summarization, intent extraction, product Q&A, returns flow). CSV or JSONL is fine; include a column/field for "category" and an identifier per prompt.

2) Input logs (redacted): recent anonymized app logs that show real user prompts and any downstream expected outputs. If you can provide JSONL with fields {timestamp, user_id_pseudonym, prompt_text, expected_response (if available), category}, that will speed up mapping. Redaction/pseudonymization is fine.

3) Success criteria: please confirm the quantitative success criteria for the POC. From our call I captured: intent accuracy >= 85% (micro-F1), relevance rating >= 4/5 on a 300-sample human eval, p95 latency < 400ms, and target cost < $X per 1k tokens. If any of those need adjusting, call them out.

Proposed evaluation plan (high level):
- You send prompt set + logs (we review format & samples).
- Redwood runs automated evals (relevance/accuracy, hallucination checks) and a performance run on a matched hardware profile.
- We produce a report with metrics, example failures, and recommended model/config (quantization/batching) for your workloads.
- Joint review call to decide acceptance and next steps.

Timeline: if we can get the sample data by EOD Friday (2028-06-15), we can run the initial eval the following week and aim to present results the week of 2028-06-26. Let me know if you need a different cadence.

Owners: from Redwood  Marissa Cole (sales lead), Marcus Lin (Customer Success), Dylan Brooks (Solutions Eng). From Stella  please confirm primary owner for dataset delivery.

Attachments: none in this message.

Thanks  Ill follow up with a shared Drive link for uploads and a HubSpot deal link.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference

Thanks Rajesh  that format looks great and pseudonymization is fine. A few quick ingestion guidelines: 
- Preferred file formats: CSV (with header) or JSONL (one JSON object per line).
- Required fields: prompt_id (string), category, prompt_text. Optional but helpful: expected_response, timestamp, device_type, user_pseudo_id.
- Please avoid nested objects in JSONL (flat key/value pairs are easiest for our pipeline).
- If any prompts include personally identifying content, please redact or replace with placeholders; we dont need raw PII for the eval.

Next steps:
1) Stella uploads the prompt set + logs to the Drive folder by EOD 2028-06-15.
2) Dylan will perform a quick format/ingest check on 2028-06-16 and confirm readiness.
3) Kickoff call (3045 min) on 2028-06-19 to align on metrics, run plan, and review acceptance criteria.

Ill send a calendar invite for June 19 (proposed 10:0010:45 AM PT) after Dylan confirms. Thanks again  excited to get started.
